scope: All managed threads; construction and retained outputs included, setup and post-sample disposal excluded. Native serial and parallel retain packed full-window output; builder also returns startup and Full owns OHLCV.
validation: Production and fixture builds, 21 focused CPU/GPU cases and 30 comparison/probe cases passed with zero skips.
limitations: Allocation only. Three samples agreed for every arm. The previous BDN timing/allocation checkpoint used a different measurement harness and is retained separately; do not infer an exact before/after byte reduction from that comparison or combine its latency with these allocation values. LatestOnly still allocates 5104 B more than native parallel. No new timing measurement or qualification change.
